method: Read-only reconstruction of preserved response usage; no inference or external billing lookups.

accounting_rules.gateway_charge: usage.cost, for RunInfra the direct service charge and for OpenRouter the gateway account charge.
accounting_rules.reported_upstream_inference_cost: usage.cost_details.upstream_inference_cost when present; shown for transparency but not automatically additive.
accounting_rules.estimated_economic_cost: For is_byok=true, gateway charge plus reported upstream inference cost; otherwise gateway charge only, avoiding double counting standard OpenRouter usage.
accounting_rules.unknowns: Missing monetary fields remain null; known totals do not assert missing charges are zero.
accounting_rules.reasoning_tokens: Reported token usage; excluded reasoning text does not remove reasoning from completion tokens or cost.

limitations: This is an estimate from provider response metadata, not a reconciled billing invoice. Credits, account-specific discounts, taxes or later adjustments are not verified.

The frozen runner budget and known_cost fields tracked usage.cost only. For BYOK requests this excludes externally billed upstream inference cost; this posthoc summary records that limitation without changing frozen artifacts.
Requested reasoning settings are preserved; response metadata does not independently attest which internal reasoning effort was applied.
